To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Higgs boson can be produced through the emission or virtual exchange of a flavon in the bulk of large extra dimensions, which may be a powerful probe of the string scale.

(i) the graviton emission and the flavon emission have the same order-of-magnitude cross-sections; (ii) the graviton exchange and the flavon exchange have the same order of magnitude; (iii) the flavon exchange can be the dominant contribution to the Higgs production cross section at high energies, and can be the only contribution to the H -> gamma gamma decay rate.
the Higgs signals from the flavor physics in the large extra dimension scenario could provide powerful probes for the string scale.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a new mechanism of Higgs production in a realistic theory with extra dimensions and its phenomenology.
the production and detection of the Higgs boson in the context of extra dimensional theories.
a new class of signals from flavor physics, which may have important implications for future collider searches.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the graviton production cross-section at LHC is not a good probe for the string scale.
the Higgs signals in flavor physics are a powerful probe of the fundamental physics of the extra dimensions and the flavor structure of the theory.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
in the presence of bulk scalars, the Higgs production and decay can be modified in ways that are not possible in the standard model.

the Higgs signals from flavons and gravitons are of the same order of magnitude if the flavons feel the same number as the gravitons of extra dimensions, and the gravitons can be excluded up to a few TeV if the flavons are not excluded by flavor physics.

the Higgs boson can provide a window to the extra dimensions.
flavor physics is an excellent tool to probe extra dimensions.
new signals of the Higgs boson may be present even when the Higgs is not coupled to any new heavy particles, as long as there is new physics in the extra dimensions.
